name: Input
description: A native single-line input with shared sizing and invalid presentation.

value.description: Current string value mapped to each platform's native form convention.

size.description: Shared control height and spacing scale.

invalid.description: Exposes invalid presentation and aria-invalid state.

disabled.description: Maps to the native disabled attribute.

readonly.description: Maps to the native readonly attribute.

required.description: Maps to the native required attribute.

clearable.description: Adds an accessible action that clears an editable non-empty value.

passwordReveal.description: Adds a visibility toggle when type is password.

clearLabel.description: Accessible label for the clear action.

showPasswordLabel.description: Accessible label for revealing a password.

hidePasswordLabel.description: Accessible label for concealing a revealed password.

leading.description: Trusted decorative or labelled content before the input.

trailing.description: Trusted decorative or labelled content after the input and before actions.

input.description: Native input event carrying the current DOM value.
